recognize_zh: 這顆巨核細胞體積很大、細胞質豐富且呈顆粒狀，但核只有一個卵圓形、不分葉的核（unilobed），周圍嗜中性球可作大小對照，常見於 5q 缺失的骨髓增生不良。
features: Very large cell, many times the diameter of adjacent neutrophils
Single round-to-oval, non-lobated nucleus with dense, finely clumped chromatin
Abundant, finely granular basophilic-to-lilac cytoplasm with a paler peripheral zone
Low N:C ratio, indicating a mature megakaryocyte despite the unilobed nucleus
Surrounding neutrophils, band forms and lymphocytes in an aspirate background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm and a single round-to-oval, non-lobated nucleus. The cell size and cytoplasmic maturity indicate a mature megakaryocyte rather than a micromegakaryocyte. Adjacent granulocytes appear unremarkable in this field. Findings represent a unilobed (monolobated) megakaryocyte, a dysplastic feature classically associated with myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q); cytogenetic studies are recommended if such forms are numerous.

ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes are small (neutrophil-sized or less) with scant cytoplasm, unlike this large cell with abundant cytoplasm.
Immature forms have high N:C ratio and basophilic agranular cytoplasm rather than abundant granular cytoplasm.
Osteoclasts contain multiple separate round nuclei rather than a single unilobed nucleus.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocyte with widely separated nuclear lobes
ddx.vs: Separated lobes appear as multiple discrete nuclei, whereas this cell has a single compact nucleus.
